question_cn: 象兵对象，双方象颜色不同（异色象），弱方防守的核心思路是：
question_en: Bishop and pawn vs. bishop with opposite-colored bishops — the defending side's core idea is:

options.text_cn: 象站在兵的前进路线上阻挡
options.text_en: Put the bishop directly in the pawn's path

options.text_cn: 用王阻挡兵的推进，异色象无法互相攻击
options.text_en: Use king to blockade, since opposite-colored bishops can't attack each other
Opposite-colored bishops always lose, resign immediately

options.text_cn: 象控制升变格，阻止升变
options.text_en: Bishop controls the promotion square to prevent promotion

explanation_cn: 异色象兵的核心元思维：双方象在不同颜色格活动，互不干扰。弱方用王阻挡兵，己方象只负责防守本色格即可。这类残局和局机会远多于同色象残局。
explanation_en: Core meta-concept: opposite-colored bishops operate on different squares and can't attack each other. Defending king blockades the pawn; own bishop holds its color. Draw chances are high.
